name: Jikji metal-type edition
summary: The surviving second volume of Jikji, a Korean Buddhist text printed in 1377 with movable cast-metal type, the oldest extant book printed this way.
description: Surviving second volume of Jikji, printed using movable cast-metal characters.
tier_reason: The scoped record is a particular configuration, local witness, trial or material application. Dependence across fields or generations on THIS referent is not established; do not inherit the importance of its broader missing family.

impact.note: One surviving volume from one temple's print run, a witness to Korean metal type that already existed; implies tier 3, below the reviewed tier 2.
